branch_failure.step: Verify v0.9.2 fresh-execution and qualification boundaries
branch_failure.cause: Three Darwin provider unit tests attempted to create directories under nonexistent /private/tmp on Linux. The same concrete setup pattern occurs in six temporary-directory constructions across three test files.
branch_failure.classification: branch-specific test portability, not analyzer failure

exact_base.cause: Different temporary Git fixture cleanup error: Directory not empty: objects. This does not explain or excuse the branch provider-test portability failure.

repair_boundary: Only test temporary-root construction changes to the resolved platform temp directory. No runtime provider, policy gate, pin, timeout, benchmark evidence or qualification authority change.
local_validation_note: First combined run selected Xcode Python3.9, which lacks sys.orig_argv/add_note and stricter fractional ISO parsing; that failure is retained. The native-preparation suite requires supported Python3.11+; CI uses3.12. A supported-interpreter run is separate evidence.
